name: Samesuga Shin'ichi
source:
Shinichi is a second-year student from class 2-C, [url=/c60]Leo's[/url] classmate and one of Leo's childhood friends. He is nicknamed "Fukahire" meaning shark fin soup. He was ill-treated by his older sister, consequently he has belief that a woman has to go out of her way on man's behalf. He is perverted and likes eroge.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tsuyokiss]Wikipedia[/url]]
